newsitem.title: UK: Europe raw cotton inquiry is thin.
newsitem.headline: Europe raw cotton inquiry is thin.

text.p: Competitively priced nearby delivery offers of Central Asian and West African cotton occasionally found favour in Portugal and Italy.
But spinner inquiry in western Europe was thin, reflecting buyer reluctance to anticipate raw material needs while the forward sales outlook for yarn and fabric remains obscure.
Markets in eastern Europe were featureless and no significant business was reported in long staple varieties.
